_comment: Seed sources shipped WITH this plugin: every url below is appended once to the installing project's
Content/FlaxAssetManager/Sources.json (recorded in its seededUrls, so a source the user removes
stays removed). Each url is then fetched, validated and code-install-gated like a typed url, and
installs nothing by itself. A project declines this file with "pluginSeed": false in its
Settings.json. Forms a url takes: http(s), file://, an absolute path, a path relative to the
project, and the macros $(PluginPath) (this plugin's folder), $(ProjectPath), $(EnginePath).
Read once per editor session; edit it and restart (or Update Plugin) to apply. Enforced rules:
1 MiB ceiling, one seed per url, no url means a warning naming that entry.
